title: seed-batch-dashboard-rhea
content:
Personal mini-dashboard: seed-batch runs (scratchpad)
Owner: Rhea Kapoor — quick capture of small experiments while iterating on batching heuristics and quant profiles. Not canonical; ephemeral notes + numbers for hand-off.

CONTEXT
- Goal: capture per-batch latency and cost signal for short sequence workloads (<=256 tokens) to decide default batch size for the low-latency tier.
- Environment: dedicated dev-pool (A100-80GB sim), runtime build: serve-v2.3-rc (kernel: fast-attn-v2).
- Keep entries compact: single-line per run, summary metrics p50/p95 in ms, tokens_out and rough cost estimate (USD cents per 1k tokens).

TABLE (most recent first)
run_id | date | model | quant | batch | seq_len | p50_ms | p95_ms | tokens_out | cost_est_cents_per_1k | notes | anomaly
R-2025-03-10-a | 2025-03-10 | rw-7b-v2 | fp16 | 8 | 64 | 28 | 45 | 512 | 6.2 | baseline after kernel tweak | no
R-2025-03-09-b | 2025-03-09 | rw-7b-v2 | int8 | 8 | 64 | 24 | 42 | 520 | 4.0 | int8 drop p50 by ~14% vs fp16; check nat loss | no
R-2025-03-07-c | 2025-03-07 | rw-7b-v2 | int8 | 16 | 64 | 40 | 78 | 1024 | 3.5 | throughput up, latency doubles for p95 | yes (p95 spike)
R-2025-03-06-d | 2025-03-06 | rw-70b | fp16 | 2 | 128 | 115 | 220 | 1536 | 25 | too large for dev pool; not representative | yes (OOM near end)
R-2025-02-28-e | 2025-02-28 | rw-7b-v2 | int8 | 4 | 32 | 18 | 30 | 320 | 3.8 | low seq len looks great; batching might be safe at 4 | no

QUICK INTERPRETATION RULES
- Use p50 for interactive SLO decisions; p95 for tail risk in production routing.
- cost_est is back-of-envelope: (gpu-time-ms * cost_per_ms) normalized to 1k tokens; not billing-accurate.
- Flagged anomalies (anomaly=yes) need follow-up: reproduce with stable seed and longer run to confirm.

NOTES TO SELF (TODOs)
- Re-run R-2025-03-07-c with kernel pinned to fast-attn-v1 to isolate kernel regression.
- Add KV-cache warmup test for >1 prefix (two-step chat) by mid-March.
- Compute precise per-token billing from observability dataset (console export) and replace rough cost_est formula.
- Try batch-aware prefix caching: if repeated prefixes, simulate cache hit ratio 30% and re-eval cost.

SHORT SNIPPETS / FORMULAE
- rough_cost_est_cents_per_1k = (p50_ms / 1000) * cost_ms_usd * 100; // cost_ms_usd approximated from reserved-pool rate ~0.000062 USD/ms -> adjust when console numbers are in
- tokens_out recorded from client-side (quick-script v0.2) — double-check tokenization config (GPT-2 BPE vs local tokenizer).

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Are we comfortable setting default batch=8 for rw-7b-v2 hosted tier given int8 results? (tradeoff: p50 improvements vs p95 tail).
- Does KV cache behavior with int8 quant materially change observed p95 under multi-turn? (need 2-turn synthetic test)
- Should we add a small canary route that forces fp16 for users on paid tier while defaulting int8 for free trial?

REFERENCES / LINKS (copied for handoff)
- JIRA INF-3421: batching heuristic spike investigation
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1289 (kernel changes merged into rc)
- Slack thread: #infra-bench-2025, thread ts: 1688792000 (search term: "int8 p95 spike")

LAST QUICK LOG (mini-run checklist)
- confirm environment snapshot (docker image id) -> written in run metadata file on node: /var/logs/bench/run-R-2025-03-10.meta
- save raw traces to s3 path: s3://redwood-dev-bench/rhea/R-2025-03-10/ (if reproducing, attach traces to Jira)

END OF SCRATCHPAD

(If this doc gets promoted to a team doc, move table into a proper sheet and add column definitions. For now: ephemeral, owned by me.)
